postal_system.assignment_rule: The complete 39,192-row La Poste snapshot contains 25 distinct 973 postal codes mapped to 22 distinct COG 2026 communes. Each code has one official assignment row.
postal_system.geometry_rule: La Poste explicitly says postal-code contours are not supplied in open data. Each code is joined by exact INSEE identity to the matching unmodified geo.api.gouv.fr commune Polygon or MultiPolygon and remains derived display geometry, never an official postal boundary.
postal_system.shared_surface_rule: 97311 and 97352 share Roura; 97318 and 97360 share Mana; 97353 and 97390 share Régina. Each pair therefore returns the same full commune display surface and does not imply a sub-commune postal perimeter.
postal_system.non_area_rule: No point, route, P.O. box or organisation object is expanded into an area.
postal_system.address_rule: No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer, delivery or land-rights row is bundled. Postal Code to Polygon to Address Context authority remains separated.
postal_system.agid_rule: Postal nodes and derived commune surfaces are linked only inside the versioned Postal Context graph. AGID identity, addresses and buildings require independent explicit evidence.

temporal_model.valid_time: Assignments are represented from the 2026-08-08 official La Poste data update.
temporal_model.known_time: Retrieval time, exact source bodies, edition, digests and AGID release time are recorded separately.
temporal_model.history_rule: A later assignment or boundary edition creates a new release and never rewrites this evidence.

quality_gates.pass: The full 39,192-row official snapshot has exactly 25 distinct 973 postal codes and 22 commune identities.
All 25 fixed postcode queries return exactly one matching commune feature, and all identities and coordinates equal the 22-feature department response.
All 25 published Polygon/MultiPolygon responses pass Turf, JSTS, ring closure, range and 20,000-position runtime gates without coordinate modification.
The three two-code commune pairs are listed and confidence is 0.90; no distinct postal boundary is claimed.
The real pack passes normalization, API lookup, metadata, bounds fit, translucent paint, clear, re-search, no-match and invalid-code tests.
No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer or land-rights data is published.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights and blockers are inventoried.
Country-specific contracts and provenance are reviewable.

The complete current official La Poste snapshot proves all 25 French Guiana postcode assignments; fixed Open Licence 2.0 geo.api.gouv.fr department and per-postcode responses supply matching real valid commune geometry without coordinate modification; it is published only as derived administrative display context, with shared surfaces disclosed, while the shared real API/app path normalizes, renders, fits, clears and re-searches it with provenance.
A source refresh and independent review pass without authority drift.
Two source refreshes pass with monitored rollback.
